Title: EVT-OP-027: Breiman's 1965 conjecture on randomly weighted self-normalized sums
Labels: open-problem, area:heavy-tails, type:research, difficulty:hard, status:research

**Status in the survey:** RESOLVED by a single unrefereed preprint of 2026: a verification target.

## Source and quote
Lenzi, arXiv:2608.24616v3 (10 Sep 2026), abstract:

> We prove Breiman’s conjecture under the first-moment assumption.

The quote was extracted from the source text, with symbols flattened; check it against the published version before citing.

## Why it matters
It is a 60-year-old conjecture with a new proof that is not yet refereed, which is where machine checking adds value.

## What the library already has
`domainOfAttraction_isStableIndex_iff`, `GCLTConverse.exists_isRegularlyVarying_tailBalance_of_tendsto`, Karamata and Tauberian tools, Poisson random measures.

## What is missing
Poisson–Dirichlet laws, the ratio-Tauberian theorem and Fourier–Mellin identities. Breiman's forward direction is a natural first milestone, estimated as medium.
